findings.problem: The same interval-wide compatibility argument is repeated in four proofs. `continuousOn_schwarzChristoffelBoundary` (lines 170-173) and `schwarzChristoffelBoundary_sub_eq` (lines 185-189) unpack `L` from `exists_tendsto_schwarzChristoffelPrimitive_sub_eq`; `schwarzChristoffelBoundary_injOn` (lines 228-233) and `collinear_schwarzChristoffelBoundary_image` (lines 240-248) unpack it from `exists_tendsto_schwarzChristoffelPrimitive_injOn_collinear`. Each then re-establishes `schwarzChristoffelBoundary a e z₀ x = L x` on `Ioo p q` from `schwarzChristoffelBoundary_eq_of_tendsto`. In the collinear proof the same pointwise equality is expanded into a manual `ext`/constructor proof that `schwarzChristoffelBoundary a e z₀ '' Ioo p q = L '' Ioo p q`. This is the file's central identification of the `extendFrom` boundary value with the analytic continuation, and it is re-derived in each theorem; a change to the boundary definition or to the Edge existential interface would require editing all four.
findings.benefit: The compatibility with the analytic continuation is stated once and reused, rather than unpacked independently in four proofs. The collinear proof uses Mathlib's `Set.EqOn.image_eq` instead of a hand-written double inclusion, and all four public theorems become uniform transfers from the same boundary continuation `L`. The helper also records that the functions supplied by the two Edge existence theorems agree on the interval, so future edits to the boundary map or to the Edge API are localized to one proof instead of four.
